title: 左门 Zuo Men
subtitle: Gate in the garden walls

model.line: Assumed: a gate on the walls layer with no hall drawn at its point, so a small default box stands there. Confidence C.
rows: gate on the walls layer, no hall drawn at this point: a small default box
platform 0.77 m, eave 4.47 m, ridge 6.38 m above the ground
hip-and-gable 歇山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

by the hall kit: 2 bays, steps on the back, front, 歇山 hip-and-gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, bracket sets 斗拱 as a painted band. From the size a source states, the rest from the typology of its hall class.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考: the eighteen gates
evidence.excerpt_zh: 園内為門十八南曰大宫門曰左右門曰東西夾道門曰東西如意門曰福園門曰西南門曰水閘門曰藻園門東曰東樓門曰鐡門曰明春門曰隨墻門曰蘂珠宫門西曰隨墻門正北曰北樓門為閘三西南為一空進水閘東北為五空出水閘為一空出水閘
evidence.summary: The Qing list of the gates of 圆明园 and of its three sluices, to set against the labels of S01.

evidence.title: 大宫門 and 出入賢良門
evidence.excerpt_zh: 大宫門五楹門前左右朝房各五楹……大宫門内為出入賢良門五楹門左右為直房前跨石橋度橋東西朝房各五楹
evidence.summary: The main gate of five bays with five-bay offices left and right; inside it 出入贤良门, five bays, with duty rooms and a stone bridge in front of it.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn as a gate on the plan of the gardens (S01).
